# situation: in a repository of the organization octo-org, the job calls
#   deploy.yml of octo-org/shared-workflows at @v1 with secrets: inherit.
# reason: secrets: inherit hands the called workflow every secret this job
#   can read, and the code that receives them is in
#   octo-org/shared-workflows at @v1, which its maintainers, or whoever
#   takes the repository over, can change to send them anywhere.
# attack: a maintainer of octo-org/shared-workflows, or whoever takes over
#   one of their accounts, moves the tag v1 to a commit whose deploy.yml has
#   a step that sends toJSON(secrets) out.
# attack-run-behavior: on the next push, the job deploy runs deploy.yml at
#   the moved v1 with every secret this job can read, by their own names;
#   toJSON(secrets) in the step expands to all of them, names and values,
#   and the step sends them.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: octo-org/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@v1
    secrets: inherit
